# HEIC test fixture

`receipt-sample.heic` is the public `examples/example.heic` fixture from
[strukturag/libheif](https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/blob/master/examples/example.heic),
downloaded on 2026-10-31. It is used only to exercise real HEIC decoding,
not as an actual customer receipt. Upstream project and license:
https://github.com/strukturag/libheif.
